summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Mechanical Draughtsman and Marine Structural Designer with 5+ years of experience in ship structural design, fabrication drawing preparation, and 2D/3D modelling for marine, offshore, and defence projects. Skilled in AutoCAD, Tribon M3, and Autodesk Inventor, with hands-on experience preparing General Arrangement (GA) plans, fabrication and erection drawings, lifting arrangements, and structural documentation, including work on the Indigenous Aircraft Carrier (IAC) for the Indian Navy. Known for delivering accurate, presentation-ready drawings that meet client and class requirements.
